title: WhisperBar — Speak messy thoughts into polished text.
excerpt: A Mac menu bar app for writing and skimming. Dictate into any app and get business-casual text, or hear a short summary of anything you copy.
content_html:
A Mac menu bar app for writing and skimming. Dictate from any app and get business-casual text ready to paste, or hear a short summary of anything you copy.

⌘⇧1

Voice → Text

Talk however you think. WhisperBar cleans grammar, punctuation, and structure, then copies the finished text so you can paste it into Slack, email, or your AI chat.

⌘⇧2

Text → Voice

Copy a doc, email thread, AI answer, or article. Hear a clear short summary so you understand it without reading every line.

Download for Mac

7-day trial · $4/month · Mac plus iPhone companion

See it in action

Watch messy speech become polished text.

A 3-minute walkthrough of both modes — voice-to-text and text-to-voice.

Voice to writing

Not a raw transcript. Actual text you can use.

Raw dictation okay codex can you look at the checkout page and figure out why the coupon field is pushing the total down on mobile and maybe just fix the spacing but don't change the desktop layout

WhisperBar Can you look at the checkout page and figure out why the coupon field is pushing the total down on mobile? Please fix the spacing without changing the desktop layout.

Business casual by default — clean enough to send, still direct enough to sound like you.

Text to voice

Skim without staring at another screen.

Copy text to your clipboard. Press the shortcut. WhisperBar summarizes it, converts it to natural speech, and plays it back. It doesn't read word by word — it understands the content and explains it to you.

<2s

To generate audio

15s

Summary length, any input size

∞

Input length — paste anything

Zoom in

Overview first. Then go deeper.

1

Copy the whole doc

Get a high-level summary of everything in one listen.

2

Hear more detail on the part that matters to you.

3

Repeat as needed

Each summary takes under 2 seconds to generate. Go as deep as you want.

Why it works

Not another dictation app.

Made for AI workflows

Say the prompt out loud and paste it into Codex, ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Slack, or email without cleaning it up first.

Polished, not robotic

Voice-to-text output is business casual. Clean enough for email, natural enough that it still sounds like you.

Explains, doesn't read

Text-to-voice summarizes first, then speaks. Like a colleague explaining a doc to you, not a screen reader.

Mac first, iPhone nearby

The daily workflow lives in your menu bar. The iPhone app captures thoughts when you are away from your keyboard.

iPhone companion

Capture away from your Mac. Polish when it matters.

Most WhisperBar work happens on Mac because that is where you write, reply, prompt, and paste. The iPhone app is the same subscription for the moments between those sessions: walking notes, quick ideas, names, follow-ups, and messages you want cleaned up before sending.

  • Record thoughts anywhere Talk naturally on iPhone and keep the polished version for later.
  • Keep names and jargon straight Add important words so product names, people, and technical terms come through correctly.
  • One subscription Mac, iPhone, 100 hours/month, and Family Sharing are included.

Pricing

One plan. Everything included.

$4/month

or $40/year — save 17%

  • Voice to polished text
  • Text to audio summary
  • 100 hours/month
  • Mac app + iPhone companion
  • Family Sharing — up to 6

Start 7-day trial
